title: Help with windows installer plz
body:
P ~ \downloads\rayhunter-v0.5.1-windows-x86_64> ./installer.exe orbic
./installer.exe : The term './installer.exe' is not recognized as the
name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or operable program. Check the
spelling of the name, or if a path was included, verify that the path is
correct and try again.
At line:1 char:1
+ ./installer.exe orbic
+ ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    + CategoryInfo          : ObjectNotFound: (./installer.exe:String) [
   ], CommandNotFoundException
    + FullyQualifiedErrorId : CommandNotFoundException

comments.body:
Hi, you are hitting a bug. The `installer` file needs to be renamed to `installer.exe`, it's wrongly named in the current release. this will be fixed in the next release

see https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/issues/521
